questions.title: USSF-153 · 10 September 2026
questions.go_definition: GO means liftoff occurs during 10 September UTC. NO-GO means no liftoff in that interval, including a scrub or delay. This is a forecasting question, not an operational launch recommendation.
questions.loss_definition: Conditional on liftoff during that UTC day: physical loss of the primary payload from liftoff through intended deployment. Total and partial loss are mutually exclusive; partial severity is the fraction of payload value lost if partial loss occurs. Booster recovery and later in-orbit operations are excluded.
questions.schedule_note: Based on the repository manifest as of 6 September 2026; this UTC day is the forecast interval, not a verified operator launch window. A changed date requires a new question ID.
